title: Laumufarþegi Worker capabilities
description: What the Worker can do for the people in a game.

entities.name: Party rooms
entities.description: Starting a room, joining it from its link, and playing it to the end, with the server as the only referee.
entities.responsibility: Keeps each room's state in its own Durable Object, applies every player's actions and timeouts one at a time through the shared rules, and sends each player only what they may see.
access: Starting a room: a signed-in icelander.net user with the games:play role, or anyone when HOST_SIGN_IN is none; same-origin requests only.
Joining a room and playing in it: anyone who knows the room's code, from this site's origin; no sign-in.
A seat: whoever presents its token.
Host actions (settings, start, next, end, kick, resetTopics): the room's host only; claimHost: any other player once the host has been disconnected for 30 s.
